note: Members saved before batches existed have no batch and must never fall into a batch group
A member in the group must see the message in the app and a member outside must not
A member with no mobile number or a foreign number can never match the app; ending-in-7 counts the last day itself
Every group but Everyone and batch depends on today; a message scheduled for later is sent to the group as it was picked, unknown whether it is worked out again
A double tap on send must not send twice
Group names are fixed English words in the logic file
The longest group name must fit the Group list on a phone
